SLE.note: Governor names the national payment switch but the report does not say the Bank runs or oversees it; sandbox is not licensing.
Nothing on consumer rules or redress.
79% is 'access to formal financial services' per the Governor, not stated as a survey share of adults with an account.

facts.fact: Bank of Sierra Leone Governor Ibrahim Stevens refers to mobile money accounts that customers transfer between through the national payment switch.
The Governor says the national payment switch lets customers transfer money between mobile money accounts and bank accounts across participating financial institutions.
The Governor describes a national payment switch connecting mobile money accounts and bank accounts across participating institutions.

SLE.note: Only a regulatory sandbox and donor-run lab and grants; no startup law, strategy, labelling or public fund.

facts.fact: The FinTech Innovation Lab at Fourah Bay College, University of Sierra Leone, was launched under the EU-supported Salone Access to Finance Project, with at least 12 start-ups to receive incubation; no cohort is yet on record.
